headline: Radware discloses breach exposing customer cloud access keys
summary: Radware reported that attackers accessed customers' account details and cloud access keys via an exposed internal Cloud WAF management API.
whyItMatters: Compromised cloud keys could allow attackers to infiltrate customer environments.
recommendedAction: Review and rotate all cloud access keys and audit API exposures.

headline: VMware vCenter Hit by Another Critical 9.8-Rated Auth Bypass Flaw After Zero-Day Exploitation
summary: Broadcom issued patches for 23 VMware vulnerabilities, including a critical CVE‑2026‑123903 authentication bypass in vCenter's Directory Service.
whyItMatters: An auth bypass could allow attackers full control of vCenter environments.
recommendedAction: Apply the latest VMware patches immediately.

headline: Iran-Aligned Volant Manticore Uses IPFS-Based KuboShell Backdoor in Espionage Campaigns
summary: The Volant Manticore group deployed a KuboShell backdoor that leverages IPFS for C2, targeting telecoms, airlines, and critical infrastructure in Cyprus.
whyItMatters: The novel IPFS-based C2 technique evades traditional detection.
recommendedAction: Monitor network traffic for IPFS usage and block unauthorized connections.

headline: European Commission confirms data theft in EU Academy breach
summary: Attackers breached the EU Academy learning platform and stole personal data of an undisclosed number of users.
whyItMatters: Compromise of EU citizen data could have regulatory and privacy implications.
recommendedAction: Notify affected users and conduct a thorough security review of the platform.

headline: Hackers compromise Check Point Servers in 22 organizations
summary: Threat actors exploited several vulnerabilities to compromise two dozen Check Point Security management servers across 22 organizations.
whyItMatters: Compromise of security management servers can give attackers control over network defenses.
recommendedAction: Apply vendor patches immediately and isolate affected management servers.

headline: McDonald's Japan data breach exposes customer location information
summary: A breach at McDonald's Japan exposed a database containing location data of users of its official smartphone app.
whyItMatters: Location data can be used for targeted attacks or privacy violations.
recommendedAction: Notify affected users and secure the app backend.

headline: ShinyHunters claims to return after FBI arrests, uses old PGP keys as proof
summary: ShinyHunters announced a return on a new leak site, citing old PGP keys as evidence after recent FBI arrests.
whyItMatters: The gang may resume extortion campaigns against breached organizations.
recommendedAction: Increase monitoring for data leak postings and verify integrity of leaked data.

headline: Police disrupt 57 illegal streaming services with 7.3 million visits
summary: Authorities from 11 countries shut down 57 illegal streaming services that collectively received over 7.3 million visits annually.
whyItMatters: Disruption reduces piracy and associated cyber threats.
recommendedAction: Continue monitoring for emerging illegal streaming sites.

headline: From Vulnerability Noise to Resilience: Rethinking Security in the AI Era
summary: RapidFort discusses how AI-driven development increases software supply chain complexity and proposes runtime visibility and automated remediation to reduce vulnerability noise.
whyItMatters: Improved visibility can help security teams focus on real risks.
recommendedAction: Evaluate adoption of runtime protection and automated remediation tools.

headline: New Shirudo tool uses AI to shield unpatched Linux systems from exploits
summary: OpenAI and Cisco released Shirudo, an open-source tool that provides temporary runtime protections for unpatched Linux systems without service restarts.
whyItMatters: It offers a stopgap defense while patches are prepared.
recommendedAction: Deploy Shirudo on vulnerable Linux hosts pending patch rollout.
